mapper.update: UPDATE hm_keyword SET keyword = #{keyword}, status = #{status}, interval_min = #{intervalMin}, notify_email = #{notifyEmail}, notify_email_addr = #{notifyEmailAddr}, notify_site = #{notifySite}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
